resources.string: All in one folder, with extension
For example %1$s. No console folders and the extension stays in the name; games with the same file name on two consoles are skipped.
ES-DE style (covers folder)
For example %1$s. A covers folder per console, as in ES-DE\'s downloaded media: pick the folder that holds your console folders.
Scraper style (media/box2d)
For example %1$s. A media/box2d folder per console, as scrapers such as Skraper write it for EmulationStation-based launchers.
Your own pattern

For a launcher none of these fits: write the path of a cover yourself, for example {system}/{name}.png. Tap to write it.
Your own cover path

Write where a cover goes below the media folder. Between braces: {system} is the console folder, {name} the game\'s file name without extension, {file} the name with extension and {retro} the name the way RetroArch writes thumbnail names. The path ends in .png, because covers are always written as PNG.
